content: A global, cross-project context layer from the extraction corpus
what_happened: Corpus held one project, flat at the root; no cross-project claim could be supported; every "recurring" pattern had to be relabelled "cross-domain within one project"
why: v1 extracted only the project it ran in; other projects were "deliberately out of scope" (Icarus manifest)
learned: A global layer needs several independent, namespaced extractions
reappeared: Partly: the second project is this meta-project, not an independent one

content: Use the Icarus extraction as primary evidence
what_happened: Its own manifest: 0 session transcripts, ~40% of Learning.md, the top of a 7,269-line HANDOFF; evidence ends 2026-09-10
learned: Extractions are second-hand; mark them so

what_happened: First parse returned 18 beliefs and 16 patterns, with no error
why: Bold titles wrapping across lines didn't match the regex
learned: **Compare parse yield to the manifest's declared counts**; a silent drop looks like clean output
changed_afterwards: Fixed; inventory now prints parsed vs declared
reappeared: Same class as Icarus F06 ("silently read 1/4 of each code window")

what_happened: Bullet IDs (`X09`) and FACT IDs repeated across files and would have silently overwritten each other in the record index
why: IDs scoped to the line, not the file

content: Check that quotes in narrative docs exist in the corpus
what_happened: Apostrophes were paired as quotation marks (false warnings); one real paraphrase was found inside quote marks ("Business, not engineering")
learned: Paraphrase in quotation marks is a hallucination vector
changed_afterwards: Sequential pairing; quote corrected to the corpus wording

content: Move the Icarus extraction with hash verification
what_happened: Every `cp` failed (zsh does not word-split `$FILES`); the hash check **passed** because both sides were empty; `rm` failed harmlessly
why: Unquoted list in zsh; verification compared two failures as equal
learned: **A check that cannot fail is not a check**; verify non-empty
changed_afterwards: Redone in Python with per-file sha256 + non-empty size check
reappeared: Same class as Icarus "Vacuous tests" (F07) and B17 "A test you haven't watched fail is a test you haven't written."

content: Global narrative docs describing the corpus
what_happened: They hardcode "ONE project"; stale the moment `alankrit-os/` was created
why: Counts written as prose, not generated
reappeared: Same class as Icarus doc drift (HANDOFF/STRATEGY)

what_happened: Most material is assistant-generated or derived from Icarus → circular evidence; risk of double-counting in the next global compile
why: Project is one day old and meta
learned: Derived claims must be tagged and excluded from frequency counts
reappeared: Open until the compiler honors the tag (O06)

content: Treat the compiled "current state" as current
what_happened: Upstream evidence is 23 days old; no refresh mechanism exists
learned: Context needs an as-of date and a refresh cadence
